description: Recent A-share announcement feed (sorted by published_at desc). Filter by `type` slug (e.g. annual_report / equity_change / restructuring) or `since` lower bound. Use when surveying market-wide disclosures over a recent window — for a specific stock prefer `announcements_stock`. ⚠️ TIME: `published_at` is when the filing actually became visible — most A-share announcements go live after the previous session's close, so a filing dated "2026-08-27" by the exchange typically became readable at ~18:00 on 2026-08-26. The scheduled-disclosure stamp is the *next* calendar day at 00:00 and is returned separately as `disclosure_date`; never read `disclosure_date` as a publication time, and never conclude a filing was published at midnight.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

since.description: ISO datetime 下限（published_at >= since，按实际可见时刻过滤，非预约披露日）。**时区后缀必填**：北京时间用 2026-08-05T00:00:00+08:00，UTC 用 2026-08-05T00:00:00Z。不带时区会被拒绝——A 股业务时间是北京时间，静默按 UTC 解释会少算 8 小时的数据。

type.description: 分类 slug 过滤（如 annual_report / equity_change / restructuring）。

name: announcements_feed
